blockers.title: The subject withdraws a live Gate 1 Class A reservation and deletes v5's Class A refusal, minting Class A eligibility by this file existing.
blockers.finding: v6 makes three coordinated changes that together move DR-117's Gate 1 Class A posture. (1) DELETION: v5's doesNot carried 'Does not open D-056 Class A.' as its second entry. v6 removes that entry and substitutes 'This file existing is not a SATISFIED-GRADE cycle and does not mark SATISFIED.' in the same position. After the substitution, the words 'Class A is not opened' occur nowhere in the subject. (2) ADDITION: a new eligibilityNote asserts 'This successor withdraws v5's express Class A reservation', preceded by the premises 'That leftover is stale', 'CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED / binds NOTHING is not a Class A bar (D-085 / D-147)', and 'Gate 1 Class A is application-grade acceptance with no express reservation (D-001 T2-02 / D-056)'. (3) RESTATEMENT: basedOn.relation repeats the withdrawal — 'withdraws the v5 express Class A reservation whose stated reason was leftover-design of unnamed EEs'. Read together these compose a complete syllogism that Gate 1 is now clear and gates 1, 2, and 3 all hold for DR-117.
whyThisIsWrong: The reservation is not v5's to be superseded by a successor artifact. It is D-137's, an ADOPTED coordinator decision, whose Decision reads 'D-056 Class A is not opened' as a flat, unconditioned sentence. D-137's own Reversibility clause requires C-D137 or a dependent act's supersession to overturn it. A CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED artifact that binds NOTHING and is AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW cannot withdraw a term of an adopted decision.

The staleness argument is refuted by the record it cites. D-159 was adopted AFTER D-157 and D-158 — that is, on exactly the post-naming facts the subject calls stale — and held: 'After this recording, D-056 Eligibility gates 2 and 3 hold for DR-117. Gate 1 Class A remains false under D-137's express reservation.' The tribunal had the closure in front of it and still held the reservation live.

The subject's own recordedInput contradicts it. dr117-ee-gate-naming.v3 at fb5e9284… — cited by the subject and recorded at D-159 — states in eligibilityEffect: 'Gate 1 Class A remains false under D-137's express reservation on preview-product-boundary-successor.v5 … does not open Class A', and carries 'Does not open D-056 Class A.' in its own doesNot. The subject relies on this artifact for its entire existingGate remeasurement while contradicting its express Gate 1 holding.

The D-147 citation is selectively quoted. D-147 does say 'CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED is not a Class A bar (D-085)', which the subject quotes. It says in the immediately adjacent sentences 'Class A is not opened. Gate 1's application-grade / no-express-reservation limb is not established here.' The recorded doctrine is that the absence of a bar is not the establishment of the limb. The subject takes the exculpatory half and omits the controlling half from the same decision.

D-001 T2-02 defines the property as a property of the review, not of the subject: 'a candidate is applicable when its independent review returns 0 blockers AND grants application-grade acceptance with no express reservation … and the coordinator then applies per route A.' Gate 1 is assessed by the independent reviewer and applied by the coordinator. A subject cannot self-assess it, and cannot withdraw a reservation in order to satisfy it.

The subject carries candidate-only limitations on its face. T2-02's express test excludes 'candidate-only limitation'. The subject is status CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING, sealRecommendation DO-NOT-SEAL, reviewStatus AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW. Asserting the no-express-reservation limb while carrying four such limitations is internally contradictory.

The subject conflates gates 2/3 with gate 1. Its eligibilityNote opens on D-159's gates-2-and-3 holding and slides to the Gate 1 withdrawal. D-159 refuses that slide in the very same sentence pair. Gates 2 and 3 concern whether the remainder is named at a condition-4/DR-G* obligation with an owner — now true. Gate 1 concerns Class A T2-02 acceptance posture — a separate limb that the naming did not touch.

It inverts the standing advisory's venue holding. CLAUDE-PPBS-V3-ADV-1, recorded at D-137 as standing and traveling as honesty work, states 'the artifact is right to refuse Class A in terms' and names its venue as 'the coordinator's recording entry, not the artifact — which is why its absence from the artifact's roster is correct.' v6 does the opposite on both limbs: it stops refusing Class A in terms, and it moves the Gate 1 adjudication into the artifact.

It breaks uniform corpus discipline. Every ADOPTED decision in this family — D-137, D-145, D-147, D-157, D-158, D-159, D-160 through D-165 — expressly disclaims 'Class A is not opened'. The subject is the only artifact in the chain to remove the disclaimer and assert withdrawal.

coordinatorSummary: REJECT. One blocker, one SHOULD-FIX, one advisory. Custody is intact: subject b2778949… at 0444 unmoved across the review, HEAD never left 5d5d778, file 08 and COORD clean at their pinned digests, and 16 of 16 cited digests reproduce. Eleven of fourteen attacks were refuted, including all four on the frozen half — the seven file-02 items and p1p2g3Mapping show zero drift, the v1-slice §7 item 8 quotation is exact, and PPBSV3-B1's egress-honesty repair is fully preserved. The existingGate remeasurement is correct class by class and is good work worth keeping. The blocker is narrow and severable: v6 removes v5's 'Does not open D-056 Class A.' from doesNot, and asserts twice — at eligibilityNote and basedOn.relation — that it 'withdraws v5's express Class A reservation.' That reservation is D-137's, not v5's, and D-159 — adopted after D-157 and D-158, on exactly the post-naming facts v6 calls stale — held that 'Gate 1 Class A remains false under D-137's express reservation.' The subject's own recordedInput dr117-ee-gate-naming.v3 says the same in its eligibilityEffect and carries 'Does not open D-056 Class A.' in its own doesNot. The subject's supporting citation to D-147 quotes 'CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED is not a Class A bar' while omitting the adjacent 'Gate 1's application-grade / no-express-reservation limb is not established here.' Under D-001 T2-02 the no-express-reservation property is a property of the independent review and the coordinator's application, not something a candidate can self-assess or self-withdraw — least of all one that is itself CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, DO-NOT-SEAL, and binds NOTHING. The repair is three edits and touches nothing else in the file. Whether the reservation should now be lifted is a fair question on a changed record; the venue is a reviewed coordinator decision, which is what standing advisory CLAUDE-PPBS-V3-ADV-1 said from the start.
